description:
Use Zedruu the Greathearted to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 2.
